column1: # Expected-result rules for the controlled decontamination spike-in.
# mode       : any (synthetic and real-panel runs) or synthetic (fixture only)
# contaminant: phix, klebsiella, all (both), or none (the unspiked baseline row)
# spike_pct  : 0.01 / 0.05 / 0.10, or all, or 0 for the baseline
# metric     : derived below from target_pairs / contaminant_pairs counts
# Missing values are WARN (step not run yet); only real violations are FAIL.
# Thresholds are deliberately loose so they hold for both the seeded fixture
# and the real EC/KP panel, which carries genuine sequencing error and a small
# amount of cross-mapping in conserved regions.
